text: but i woulkdnt use shell scripts like tsz did. use the ts cli we have
resolution: The bless-system adaptation in PLATMOD_PLAN.md §3 is specified as a TS CLI command, not shell scripts: 'rjit player bless' lives in cli/commands/ and rebundles into tools/rjit.js like every CLI change, per the rjit-cli pipeline. Only the PRINCIPLE is lifted from the frozen tsz/scripts/bless-compiler reference (build-fresh-or-refuse, blessed copy + stamp with commit/date/binary-sha/source-hash, --status and --diff verbs, HUMAN-ONLY promotion); the bash implementation stays dead. §6 item 1 records the ruling verbatim. Doc edited on disk only; commit awaits supervisor order.
